title: Aurekai WeightOps Weight Proof Bundle
description: Output of `akai weights prove`. A portable proof bundle that verifies model provenance, compression fidelity, capability coverage, and runtime compatibility — without requiring the full weight tensors.

source_proof.description: Verifiable hash of original weight source commit / release.

chunk_proof.description: Merkle root of all weight chunks.

eval_proof.description: Hash of benchmark eval results at reference checkpoint.

capability_proof.description: Verifiable hash of capability coverage for the given recipe.

compression_proof.description: Proof of lossless or quantization-bounded compression.

runtime_compat_proof.description: Proof of Aurekai runtime ABI compatibility.
